page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-2t is a specialized accelerator-equipped server instance designed for intensive machine learning workloads. The system is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 224.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 2.15 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing its resource allocation entirely on compute and acceleration.

The core capability of this server is driven by two integrated Google TPU v5p accelerators, which deliver a combined total of 190 GB of specialized VRAM. This hardware configuration is highly optimized for deep learning tasks, including large language model training, neural network inference, and parallelized data science computations. By offloading matrix operations to the dedicated TPU hardware, the instance offers high qualitative cost efficiency for specialized AI workloads compared to general-purpose CPU configurations.

Because the instance lacks local storage, data must be streamed from external storage solutions, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. However, the high-density configuration of 104 dedicated vCPUs ensures that data preprocessing and input pipeline management do not bottleneck the dual TPU accelerators. This makes the server highly suitable for distributed training setups, large-scale transformer models, and high-throughput inference pipelines.
